metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 1986 · The Frog Prince
metas.description: Children's musical based on Grimm's fairy tale of The Frog-King. A young girl learns how to be a good friend and princess with the help of a "tall frog."

metas.name: 2 · ★ 5.8 · 1987 · Sleeping Beauty
metas.description: Feature-length, live-action musical version of the classic fairy tale by Charles Perrault.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.5 · 1987 · Hansel and Gretel
metas.description: After being told to leave their home by their mother, Hansel and Gretel wrongly walk into the 'North woods' were they discover a delicious gingerbread house. Unbeknown to them it's a witch that lives there.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 5.4 · 1987 · Red Riding Hood
metas.description: The faithful little girl must brave the forest and the big, bad wolf to bring her grandmother a basket of goodies in this musical version of the classic fairytale.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 4.7 · 1987 · The Emperor's New Clothes
metas.description: In Europe several several centuries ago, a group of prisoners about to be executed are freed as part of the celebration of the upcoming marriage of the emperor's daughter, Princess Gilda, to a very rich prince from another country...

metas.name: 6 · ★ 5.3 · 1987 · Rumpelstiltskin
metas.description: A musical version of the classic story about a miller's daughter who receives help from a mischievous dwarf, then ends up over her head. Now, she and a mute servant girl may be the only hope for her baby son, John.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.9 · 1987 · Beauty and the Beast
metas.description: To save her father, a girl who always puts others before herself promises to live her life in a lavish castle with a strange beast.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 6.4 · 1987 · Snow White
metas.description: The ageless tale of a beautiful young princess whose jealous stepmother orders her killed so that she will be 'the fairest in the land.' When the huntsman takes pity on her, he takes her to the house of the seven dwarfs.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 6.1 · 1988 · Puss in Boots
metas.description: Delightful tale of a cat who becomes a sharp gentleman and sets out to restore his master's name and wealth after he gives Puss a pair of magic boots.
